instruction: Okay, now you are standing on the stairs facing towards the wall, turn right and go up the stairs until you reach the top of the staircase. Now in front of you there are four bar stools, slightly turn to your left and go straight towards the cupboard, which is in front of you. Now slightly turn to your left and move forward towards the open entrance, which is in front of you. Now slightly turn to your left and go straight through the open entrance, which is in front of you. Now you are standing in the washroom facing towards the mirror, turn behind and exit the washroom. Now in front of you there is a big window, go straight towards the window by passing the dining table, which is on the left side and the mirror, which is on the right side. Now you are facing towards the window and this is the end point.
